subject.title: Feature request: keep menu bar usage visible on inactive displays

question: Should CodexBar own an opt-in nonstandard status-item rendering mode to counter macOS inactive-display dimming?
rationale: The request fits CodexBar’s glanceable menu-bar purpose, but only maintainers can decide whether the visual benefit warrants diverging from native template rendering and carrying a best-effort platform-specific mode.

options.title: Prototype an opt-in mode
options.body: Add a default-off experiment using the narrowest viable rendering change, gated on multi-display visual proof and no regression to native default behavior.

options.title: Keep native dimming
options.body: Document that inactive-display contrast is controlled by macOS and retain template rendering without another display preference.

recommendation.title: Prototype an opt-in mode
recommendation.body: Add a default-off experiment using the narrowest viable rendering change, gated on multi-display visual proof and no regression to native default behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent status-item history and merge provenance make steipete the strongest available owner for the rendering-policy decision.
